card.title: Closer on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

mechanism: A agrees to reconnection while making its timing and emotional sequence preserve A's preferred evening boundaries.
confusable: Unlike a mutually negotiated limit alone, A must redefine repair to favor their comfort when B raises unresolved hurt.
comparison: D95-a schedules repeated bounded dinners; D95-b moves difficult material into email A can read later.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
